language.label: Language
language.description: What the dashboard reads in. Reports and guides already written keep the language they were written in.

density.label: Density
density.note: Compact fits more on the screen. A narrow window is always compact.

liveAdvice.label: Advice during a game
liveAdvice.description: The keep guide, what the opponent may be holding and the matchup brief, in casual games and on the ranked ladder. Events never show them, and the sideboard plan between games stays either way.

saveFailed: It was not saved. Try again.
restartNeeded: This takes effect the next time the app starts.

keyField.label: Key
keyField.hint: Shown only while you type it. Kept on this computer.

writing.statusFailed: The app did not say whether a key is set.
writing.noKey: No Claude key is set. Each report gives you its prompt to copy, and takes the answer you paste back.
writing.keyWithModel: A Claude key is set. Reports are written by {{model}} when you press the button that says so.
writing.keyNoModel: A Claude key is set. Reports are written when you press the button that says so.
writing.configFile: The key and the model are set in the app's config file.
writing.claudeSubtitle: With a key of your own, a report is written when you press its button, and what it cost is shown on it. With none, each report gives you its prompt to copy.
writing.claudeRemoveBody: Reports go back to giving you their prompt to copy. What is already written stays.
writing.modelHint: What each report cost is measured and shown on the report.
writing.topdeckSubtitle: A free key from TopDeck.gg adds its tournaments to the field.
writing.topdeckRemoveBody: The field stops taking tournaments from TopDeck.gg. What is already here stays.

sources.dataFolderHint: One folder on this computer. Nothing in it leaves the computer unless you turn that on.
sources.arenaNotFound: The app did not find Arena's log. Give it the file's place.
sources.arenaFound: The app found it where Arena writes it.
sources.dateOrderHint: The order of the day and the month in the log's dates.
sources.yourNameHint: The game's log never says which player is you.
sources.logsFolderNone: Nothing is read from Magic Online until a folder is set.
sources.logsFolderSet: Each game is read once it ends.
sources.decksFolderNone: Your .dek exports are not read until a folder is set.
sources.decksFolderSet: Each .dek export here is read with the game logs.

cardData.title: Card data
cardData.none: No card data yet. The deck guides need it.

backup.subtitle: A copy of your matches, made once a day and checked after it is made.
backup.keepHint: The oldest is removed when a new one is made.
backup.restored: Restored. This takes effect the next time the app starts.
backup.offsite: A folder that Dropbox or OneDrive already copies keeps a backup off this computer at no cost.
backup.lastMadeSized: The last backup was made {{when}} and holds {{size}}.
backup.triedWithOlder: It was tried {{when}}. The one before it is still in the folder.
backup.triedNone: It was tried {{when}}. No backup is in the folder.
backup.restoreBody: Every match in the app is replaced by what the file holds. To keep what is here now, back up first.

app.subtitle: How the app starts, closes and stays up to date.
app.startDescription: Matches are recorded from the moment the computer is on, before you open Arena or Magic Online.
app.keepRunning: Keep running when the window is closed
app.keepRunningDescription: Matches are still recorded with the window closed. Opening the app again brings the window back.
app.checkForUpdatesDescription: At launch and once a day, the app reads one small file from the project's releases on GitHub to learn whether a new version exists, and downloads it in the background when one does. Nothing about you or your matches is sent.
app.diagnosticDescription: Writes much more detail to the log, for a bug report. Turning it on or off restarts the tracker for a moment.
app.exportNote: Export diagnostics makes a zip of the logs and the app's settings, with every key removed, to attach to a bug report. Your matches are never in it.
app.welcomeSteps: The welcome steps: the language, which you play, and Arena's or Magic Online's setup.

update.store: The Microsoft Store keeps this copy up to date.
update.development: A development run never updates itself.
update.unsupported: This copy does not update itself.
update.currentChecked: This is the newest version, checked {{when}}.
update.ready: Version {{version}} is ready. It installs the next time you quit the app.
update.failed: The last check failed. The reason is in the log.
update.failedWhen: The last check failed {{when}}. The reason is in the log.

sharing.title: Sharing your drafts
sharing.subtitle: Drafts shared by players become card ratings that anyone can download, for the queues nobody else measures.
sharing.shareOn: On. Each draft is sent once its games are over, never during a game.

sentList.event: The event, the set, and the hour the draft started and ended.
sentList.picks: Every pack you saw and the card you took from it.
sentList.deck: The deck you built, and each game's result, who played first and how many turns it took.
sentList.opponent: The opponent's colours, when the app read them.
sentList.rank: Your Limited rank's tier, when the log has it.
sentList.install: A random id for this installation, the app's version and the operating system.

sharing.noDraftYet: Once you finish a draft, what it would send is shown here.
sharing.seeSent: See what your last draft sent
sharing.seeWouldSend: See what your last draft would send
sharing.deletedNone: The server held no draft of yours.
sharing.notDeleted: The server did not answer. Nothing was deleted. Try again.
sharing.notMade: No new id was made. Try again.
sharing.installationHint: A random id, made on this computer. It is how your drafts are told from another player's, and how they are found when you delete them.
sharing.makeNewBody: The drafts already sent stay where they are, under the old id. With a new id they can no longer be found from this computer, so they can no longer be deleted from here. To delete them, do it before making a new id.
sharing.deleteBody: Every draft sent under this installation's id is deleted from the server. Ratings already published from them are not recomputed until the next night. Your drafts on this computer stay as they are.
